title: Range against launch angle
brief:
plots: range (m) against launch angle, with u = 20 m/s and no air resistance; line markers chart
points: 0 degrees 0.0 m, 15 degrees 20.4 m, 30 degrees 35.3 m, 45 degrees 40.8 m, 60 degrees 35.3 m, 75 degrees 20.4 m, 90 degrees 0.0 m
html:
<script>
const u = 20, g = 9.8;
const data = [[0, 0.0], [15, 20.4], [30, 35.3], [45, 40.8], [60, 35.3], [75, 20.4], [90, 0.0]];
const c = Visual.chart({ x: [0, 90], y: [0, 45], xLabel: "launch angle (degrees)", yLabel: "range (m)" });
let angle = 45;

function rangeAt(deg) {
  return u * u * Math.sin(2 * deg * Math.PI / 180) / g;
}

function draw() {
  c.clear();
  const R = rangeAt(angle);
  c.fn(x => rangeAt(x), { color: "var(--muted)", dashed: true });
  c.line(data);
  c.dots(data);
  c.vline(angle, `${angle}°`);
  c.dots([[angle, R]], { color: "var(--warn)" });
  if (angle === 60) c.dots([[30, rangeAt(30)]], { color: "var(--good)" });
  c.readout([
    `u = ${u} m/s, no air resistance`,
    `angle = ${angle}°`,
    `R = ${R.toFixed(1)} m`
  ]);

  let msg;
  if (angle === 0) msg = "The ball never leaves the ground, so the range is zero.";
  else if (angle === 45) msg = "This is the peak of the curve, the biggest range.";
  else if (angle === 60) msg = "It is lower, and it matches the 30 degree throw.";
  else msg = `At ${angle}°, the range is ${R.toFixed(1)} m.`;
  Visual.state(`Range against launch angle, u = 20 m/s: at ${angle}°, R = ${R.toFixed(1)} m. ${msg}`);
}

Visual.on("angle", v => { angle = v; draw(); });
draw();
</script>
